articles.title: Sony Announces PS5 Price Increase Starting May 2026
articles.summary: Sony Interactive Entertainment announced a significant price increase for PS5 consoles in Taiwan and Hong Kong, with digital edition seeing the highest increase of 23.4% due to rising component costs.
key_points: PS5 Digital Edition price increases by 23.4% in Taiwan
Standard PS5 increases by 13.7% in Taiwan
PS5 Pro and PlayStation Portal also affected
Price hike due to memory and key component cost increases

articles.title: OpenAI Partners with MediaTek and Qualcomm on Custom Smartphone Chips
articles.summary: Analyst Ming-Chi Kuo reports OpenAI is developing custom smartphone processors with MediaTek and Qualcomm, targeting mass production by 2028 for AI agent phones.
key_points: OpenAI developing 'AI agent phones' with custom chips
Luxshare serves as exclusive system design partner
Expected mass production in 2028
Final specifications to be determined by end of 2026

articles.title: Microsoft and OpenAI Renegotiate Partnership Agreement
articles.summary: Microsoft and OpenAI have restructured their partnership, ending exclusive arrangements and removing controversial AGI clauses for greater transparency and flexibility.
key_points: End of exclusive Azure cloud partnership
Removal of controversial AGI ownership条款
OpenAI can now use other cloud providers
Microsoft remains primary cloud partner

articles.title: Waymo Expands Autonomous Driving to 20+ Cities
articles.summary: Waymo's sixth-generation autonomous driving technology has been validated in over 20 US cities, with costs reduced by half and potential expansion to London and Tokyo.
key_points: Sixth-gen Waymo Driver technology validated
Cost reduction of 50% compared to previous generation
Expansion plans for London and Tokyo markets
Full autonomous operation without safety drivers

articles.title: TSMC Reports Strong AI Chip Demand

key_points: Record quarterly revenue driven by AI chip orders
Strong demand from Nvidia and other AI chip makers
Optimistic forecast for continued AI growth
Expansion of advanced manufacturing capacity

articles.title: Samsung Profit Triples on AI Memory Demand
articles.summary: Samsung Electronics reports profit tripling due to AI-driven memory market growth, with strong demand for high-bandwidth memory chips from AI server manufacturers.
key_points: Profit triples year-over-year
AI server demand drives HBM memory sales
Strong pricing power in memory market
Increased investment in memory production capacity

articles.title: Intel Faces Worst Decline in 17 Months
articles.summary: Intel shares suffer their worst decline in 17 months following weak earnings forecast, highlighting challenges in competing with AI-focused chipmakers.
key_points: Weak quarterly earnings forecast
Struggles to compete in AI chip market
Server chip sales decline
Increased competition from AMD and ARM-based chips

key_points: AI simulation reduces building design time by 60%
Improved energy efficiency predictions
Real-time optimization of building systems
Integration with BIM and CAD workflows
